author: Mark Atwood
text: API contract risk: HIGH — two P1 spec-mandated callability gaps surface (JMAP-1j9k.12 ifInState absent from all three /set methods; JMAP-1j9k.13 calendar_event_copy missing four standard RFC 8620 §5.4 args), plus four P2 canonical-template divergences from jmap-mail-client (create/destroy shapes, sort lockout, non_exhaustive on params, missing 'extra' flatten field) and two P3 polish items. A caller depending on this API in 0.x.y will need optimistic-concurrency primitives and atomic copy semantics; they have no way to express either through the current surface.
